title: Replace toolbar table controls with hover-based column/row controls, resize, and header-row toggle
description: Address item 8 of `novas-tasks.md` (`referencia-6.png`): today, adding/removing table rows/columns only works via the contextual button group in the always-visible `EditorToolbar.tsx` (+Linha/−Linha/+Coluna/−Coluna, only shown when `state.inTable`). Replace this with controls that appear on hover directly over the table itself: a horizontal strip above the table for column add/remove (with per-column '+' insertion points, not just append-at-end), a vertical strip to the left for row add/remove, visible column-width drag handles (column resize already works via `Table.configure({ resizable: true })` in `extensions.ts` — keep it, just ensure the hover controls don't fight with the existing `.column-resize-handle` CSS), and a toggle to mark whether the first row is a header row (rendered with the existing light-gray `TableHeader` background). This task's controls fully replace the toolbar's table button group, since TASK-103 removes the fixed toolbar entirely.
acceptanceCriteria: Hovering over a table reveals add/remove controls for rows (left edge) and columns (top edge), replacing the toolbar's +Linha/−Linha/+Coluna/−Coluna buttons
Controls are cleanly organized (unlike the rough `dropdown.png`-era '...'/'+' strip) with clear affordance for inserting at a specific position, not just appending
Column resize (drag) continues to work via the existing `resizable: true` Tiptap table config
A control lets the user toggle whether the table's first row renders as a header (gray `TableHeader` background) on/off after table creation, not just at insertion time
The toolbar's table-specific button group in `EditorToolbar.tsx` is removed once these controls are in place

steps.details: New component (e.g. `TableControls.tsx` in `apps/admin/src/features/editor/`) that renders on table hover, with row-insert points along the left edge and column-insert points along the top edge, using Tiptap table commands (`addRowAfter`, `deleteRow`, `addColumnAfter`, `deleteColumn`, etc.).
Add a control (e.g. small button in the top-left corner of the table on hover) that toggles the first row between `tableCell` and `tableHeader` node types for all cells in that row.
Delete the `state.inTable` contextual button group from `EditorToolbar.tsx` now that hover controls cover the same actions.

Insert a table, hover to reveal controls, add/remove rows and columns from arbitrary positions, resize a column by drag, toggle the header row, and confirm styling matches the editorial design system.

technicalNotes: Current table config lives in `apps/admin/src/features/editor/extensions.ts` (`Table.configure({ resizable: true })`); toolbar buttons live in `apps/admin/src/features/editor/EditorToolbar.tsx`.
`blockInsert.ts`'s `tableContent(3,3)` hardcodes the first row as `tableHeader` at insertion time — the new toggle must be able to flip this after the fact too.
TASK-103 (fixed toolbar removal) depends on this task landing first, so table editing capability is never regressed.
